title: Market Saturation Index
scenario: Identify cities where the ratio of 'active' drivers to 'active' riders has dropped below 0.1 for 3 consecutive days.
tableSchema: trips (city_id INT, driver_id INT, rider_id INT, request_date DATE)
hint: Count distinct drivers and riders daily, then compare ratio.
correctQuery: WITH DailyActivity AS (SELECT city_id, request_date, COUNT(DISTINCT driver_id) as d_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT rider_id) as r_cnt FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT city_id FROM (SELECT city_id, request_date, (d_cnt::NUMERIC/r_cnt) as ratio, LAG(d_cnt::NUMERIC/r_cnt, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY city_id ORDER BY request_date) as p1, LAG(d_cnt::NUMERIC/r_cnt, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY city_id ORDER BY request_date) as p2 FROM DailyActivity) t WHERE ratio < 0.1 AND p1 < 0.1 AND p2 < 0.1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE trips (city_id INT, driver_id INT, rider_id INT, request_date DATE);
